title: AgentRulesSetParams
description: The agent whose rule is being written, and the whole document. The document is text rather than a parsed object: what a person edits is the rule, and sending it as JSON would let the wire normalise away the field spelling they are looking at.

document.description: One rule document, in the grammar contracts/ does not restate: internal/agentdriver owns it, and it is the same grammar the shipped rules are written in. The backend compiles it before it is stored, so a document that could never answer is refused while the person is looking at it. 64 KiB is the engine's bound on this field.
